author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Google Gemini step by step. In this beginner-friendly tutorial, I’ll show you how to write content, analyze files, create images, organize chats, and use Gemini directly inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and other Google apps.

We’ll also look at Canvas, connected apps, notebooks, NotebookLM, image generation, and more so you can get the most out of Google’s AI assistant.

In this video you'll learn how to:
- Use Google Gemini for writing and productivity
- Analyze spreadsheets and documents with AI
- Create and refine content in Canvas
- Generate AI images and media
- Connect Gemini with Google Calendar, Gmail, and Drive
- Organize chats with notebooks and NotebookLM
- Use Gemini directly inside Google apps

If you want to get started with Google Gemini, this tutorial will walk you through everything step by step.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Get Google Gemini: https://gemini.google.com
